text:
sam.ops: hey sec — customer (FinTrust) hit us with a security questionnaire. they want a "chain of custody" for RBAC changes and a SIEM-friendly export of KMS usage for their tenant last month. attached excerpt pasted below. can sec confirm what we can provide and redaction rules?

maya.sec: can you paste the exact fields they asked for? typically we provide time-bounded IAM change logs, KMS audit events (key usage + envelope IDs), and a signed bundle hash, all redacted for tenant IDs we don't control. also want the ticket number for the RBAC change. :thinking_face:

sam.ops: excerpt — "Provide all RBAC modifications (who/what/when), KMS decrypt/encrypt operations where tenant key material was involved, and proof of log integrity (hashes + signing). Prefer machine-readable (json/csv) and timeframe 2025-02-01 to 2025-02-28."

jon.infra: I can run an export from the audit API. example command:
```
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $AUDIT_TOKEN" "https://audit.redwood.ai/api/v1/events?tenant=fintrust&from=2025-02-01T00:00:00Z&to=2025-02-28T23:59:59Z&types=iam_change,kms_op" > fintrust_audit_raw.json
```
sample line (will redact tenant_id & IPs):
`{"ts":"2025-02-07T14:12:03Z","actor":"svc-ops-jen","type":"iam_change","detail":"granted role:reader to svc-fintrust-qa","ticket":"INFR-4321"}`

jon.infra: note — KMS returns envelope IDs but not plaintext keys; we can include envelope_id, key_id, op_type. we should strip caller IPs and any customer PII.

deploy-bot: export-job started by jon.infra at 2025-03-04T09:38:20Z. job id: export-3076543300.

eli.sre: +1 on redaction. we also need to provide log integrity proof. plan: create tarball -> compute SHA256 -> sign with sec-release key. example: `tar czf fintrust_audit_202502.tar.gz fintrust_audit_raw.json && sha256sum fintrust_audit_202502.tar.gz > fintrust.sha256 && gpg --armor --sign --local-user sec-release@redwood.ai fintrust.sha256`

lara.compliance: customer also asked for KMS rotation history for the target timeframe. rotation was performed for tenant KEK on 2025-02-15T03:12:07Z, rotation-record: rot-20250215-19. we can include rotation metadata (key_id, prev_key_fingerprint, rotation_ticket). will redact account ids.

sam.ops: perfect. two asks from me: 1) can we get the export with redactions + signed hash by EOD tomorrow? 2) include a short README describing redaction policy for each field (what we keep vs mask). i'll share back to FinTrust.

jon.infra: i can produce the redacted json and the signed artifact by EOD tomorrow, but need approval for shipping to their SFTP. pending approval from compliance. link to internal ticket: https://redwood.internal/infra/tickets/INFR-4321 (contains change diff).

maya.sec: approved for transfer to customer SFTP. add an incident note referencing CVE triage — we triaged CVE-2024-XXXX in Jan and it is unrelated to these RBAC changes. annotate bundle with `sec-review:triaged` label. :white_check_mark:

sam.ops: thx all — i'll update FinTrust and confirm preferred SFTP path. tagging @lara.compliance for final delivery approval. :thumbsup:
